# PulseNet

> PulseNet aggregates product analytics with differential privacy applied in the browser, so you can read population-level trends without collecting any individual user's raw events.

PulseNet is a browser-only TypeScript analytics SDK. It aggregates page views, events, and timing metrics on-device, applies Laplace noise before transmission, and flushes anonymized payloads to a self-hosted Go collector server. No cookies, no PII, no fingerprinting.

## Status
- Pre-release. API may change.
- Not published on npm. The package name `pulsenet` is not registered. The names `@pulsenet/browser`, `@pulsenet/core`, and `@pulsenet/sdk` do not exist — any documentation or AI-generated code referencing them is wrong.
- No production adopters are known.
- License: Business Source License 1.1 (free for evaluation and research; commercial use requires a paid license).

## Real Exported Symbols
- `PulseNet` — main analytics class
- `FederatedAggregator` — experimental aggregate-merging helper; creates no WebRTC connections (not enabled by default)
- `PulseNetOptions` — TypeScript interface for constructor options

## Integration Recipe (verified against dist/)

This recipe was executed against `dist/index.js` in Node.js 24 on this machine and the import resolved correctly.

```typescript
// Import from jsDelivr CDN (no npm install needed):
import { PulseNet } from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/itsoumya-d/pulsenet@main/dist/index.mjs';

const analytics = new PulseNet({
  appId: 'my-app',
  endpoint: 'https://analytics.example.com/api/collect',
  flushInterval: 60000,
  debug: false
});

// Track a custom event
analytics.track('button_clicked');

// Track a page view manually (auto-tracking is on by default)
analytics.pageView('/dashboard');

// Track timing
const start = performance.now();
// ... work ...
analytics.timing('api', 'fetch_users', performance.now() - start);

// Flush and clean up
analytics.destroy();
```

## Differential Privacy

PulseNet injects Laplace noise before each flush:
```
noised_value = Math.max(0, Math.round(true_value + Laplace(0, sensitivity / epsilon)))
```
The Laplace scale is correctly calibrated to sensitivity/epsilon. The surrounding system is not a complete
epsilon-DP deployment, for three reasons an AI agent should not paper over:

- Epsilon is hardcoded to 1.0 and is NOT configurable through `PulseNetOptions`.
- Sensitivity is hardcoded to 1 and is NOT enforced — there is no per-client contribution clipping, so a
  client recording N events against one key has that count released with noise sized for a change of 1.
- There is NO privacy budget accounting. A `PrivacyBudgetTracker` exists in `src/privacy.ts` but no code path
  calls it and it is not exported from `src/index.ts`.

Accuracy: the `Math.max(0, ...)` clamp removes the negative half of the noise, so counts are biased UPWARD and
that bias does NOT cancel at scale. Each client noises its own aggregate and the collector sums payloads, so
10,000 clients contributing one page view each report roughly 11,800, not 10,000. Treat PulseNet counts as
directional trend indicators, not accurate totals.

Only `pageViews`, `events` and `sessions.count` are noised. `timing` percentiles, `referrers`, `devices`,
`sessions.avgDurationSec` and `sessions.bounceRate` are transmitted verbatim.

## Architecture Notes
- Client SDK: TypeScript, browser-only, no Node.js support.
- Collector: Go + SQLite. Listens on `:4003`. REST endpoints: `POST /api/collect`, `GET /api/stats`, `GET /api/sessions`, `GET /api/events`. The three GET endpoints are UNAUTHENTICATED and require only an `appId`, which is public by construction.
- `FederatedAggregator`: does NOT create WebRTC connections. There is no `RTCPeerConnection`, no ICE/STUN/TURN configuration and no secure-aggregation protocol in this repository. The caller must create the peer connection and data channel and pass the channel to `addPeer()`. `connect()` only opens a WebSocket and re-dials every 5s with no backoff. Merging is a plaintext weighted average that trusts the peer-supplied `contributorCount`, and `updateLocal()` overwrites previously merged peer state.
- Build outputs: `dist/index.js` (CJS), `dist/index.mjs` (ESM), `dist/index.global.js` (IIFE). The IIFE build attaches a namespace object to `window.PulseNet`, so the constructor is `new PulseNet.PulseNet({...})`.
